description: This Kotlin source file defines an Android Activity named ContentInfoActivity responsible for displaying detailed information about a content item, fetching data from specific endpoints, and handling video playback via ExoPlayer. It includes UI initialization, network requests, and playback management, with distinctive features like fetching info from /api/info/{id} and initiating playback with /api/play.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that fetches content info and manages video playback.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI, loads poster, and fetches content details by ID.

methods.name: fetchInfo
methods.description: Fetches content details from server and updates UI.

methods.name: onWatchNowClicked
methods.description: Handles user action to initiate content playback.

methods.name: startPlayback
methods.description: Sets up ExoPlayer with media URL and starts playback.
